 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The correctly spelt word is 'Supersede'.**

 
• **The word 'Supersede' is a verb, which means 'to take the place of (a person or thing previously in authority or use); to replace'.**
 
• **For Example -** 
 
 
• The new law will supersede the old one.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be **'Supersede'.**
